subject: Portal steward assignment + short-lived token audit for CAIQ upload
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@halcyonhealth.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor portal + CAIQ upload — steward + token question

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro during yesterday's call. We have our security team ready to onboard Redwood on our Vendr instance (Halcyon Health Org). Before we kick off the upload, a couple of quick asks so we can scope the work: 

- Is it possible for you to assign a portal steward who will own evidence uploads and role mappings? We prefer one primary contact + one backup.
- For automated CAIQ ingestion, we need a short-lived API token for a one-hour window (we rotate tokens centrally). Do you accept scoped tokens from vendors, or would you rather share a read-only service account we can use?

We also have a template CAIQ gaplist that we can pre-fill if you send over the current SOC 2 scope and the primary contact.

Best,
Anika Shah
Security Programs, Halcyon Health
---
Halcyon Health (external)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor portal + CAIQ upload — steward + token question

Hi Anika — great to meet you.

Quick answers:
- Stewarding: happy to assign a primary steward and backup. I'll put Karthik (technical onboarding) as primary and Naomi (security lead) as backup. Karthik will own the portal profile, evidence uploads, and the CAIQ mapping. Naomi will own SOC 2 cross-checks and evidence provenance.
- Tokens: we prefer short-lived scoped tokens that map to a single API role (CAIQ:write, profile:read). If Halcyon can provide a one-hour token we can consume via the ingestion job, that works best. If SSO/service account is required on your side, we can work the SAML assertions — either approach is fine.

Next steps I propose:
1) Halcyon sends a scoped token (1 hour) or a service-account SSO stub to portal-admin@halcyonhealth.com.
2) We'll run a single ingest to push the CAIQ + attachments. We'll send back a gaplist CSV with proposed mitigation evidence mapping.
3) Naomi will review SOC 2 mapping and flag any items needing runbook/proof.

I've attached our onboarding checklist and an internal CAIQ gap review template to speed things along.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
(attachment stubs: onboarding-checklist.md, caiq-gap-review-template.xlsx)

Hi Rafael / Karthik —

Thanks for the plan. Per procurement/security we can issue a 60-minute scoped token (expires 2026-09-08T16:30Z). Attached is the token manifest and the SSO guide in case you prefer the service-account flow.

Attachments:
- sso-setup-guide.pdf (pdf, 240KB)
- caiq-gaplist-20260907.csv (csv, 8KB)
- token-manifest.txt (txt, contains single-use token metadata)

Notes from our side:
- The token scope is limited to CAIQ:write and Profile:metadata:read.
- Please confirm you will NOT store the token after ingestion; we log any long-lived secret storage.
- We expect Redwood to mark the profile as "under-review" after upload so Halcyon can track manual reviews.

Let us know when you start the ingest window so we can watch logs from our side.

Regards,
Portal Admin (Halcyon Health)

Hi team — quick status update from Redwood: 

1) Ingest window: we consumed the scoped token at 2026-09-09T22:30:00Z and completed the CAIQ ingest at 22:37:12Z. Token was zeroed immediately after completion.
2) Gaplist: attached is our annotated gaplist (caiq-gaplist-20260907-annotated.csv) where we map each CAIQ question to either: SOC2-report section, public docs link, or requested evidence. There are 7 rows we flagged as "needs customer artifact": encryption-in-transit key rotation schedule, offline backups proof, privileged access change audit samples, and three minor policy confirmations.
3) Next actions: Anika — can you provide the following artifacts where available?
   - KMS rotation policy extract (redacted ok)
   - A sample privileged-access change ticket (redacted) showing approval and timestamp
   - S3/infrastructure backup retention config export (redacted ok)

Naomi will run a SOC 2 crosswalk and open any auditor-facing notes if needed. Rafael — I'll let you coordinate any procurement redlines if Halcyon needs PO confirmation.

Thanks — Karthik
